services.label: MetaMCP app
services.detail: Live gateway health is probed server-side at /health; browser links use the metamcp.local friendly name because critical cannot resolve mDNS .local names.

services.label: MetaMCP Postgres
services.detail: Container metamcp-pg was previously verified healthy as the internal MetaMCP database.

access.note: LAN gateway is reachable at the URL below and still requires gateway authentication. Friendly name metamcp.local (mDNS) resolves to 192.168.0.20 for browsers on the LAN; the dashboard server probes the raw IP /health endpoint because critical cannot resolve mDNS .local names. The dashboard stores only URLs, never credentials/keys.
